title: Progress Log Bounds: provider-run details stay responsive

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.132 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.132 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow progress runtime release; focused happy-dom coverage plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on a fresh deployed v0.15.130 provider-run blocker report, not a completed v0.15.132 ZIP/log audit. A fresh deployed audit is required before claiming clean output or Texture 100.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.130 UX Studio provider run blocked before ZIP capture after opening generation progress details and hitting a Chrome Page Unresponsive dialog.
The ProgressPanel activity log no longer auto-expands while deliverables are actively generating, preventing long provider logs from immediately mounting in the workspace.
Merged activity entries are memoized and the expanded log renders only the latest 80 entries with a visible count note.
Short cascade-sync logs still auto-open because they explain user-triggered background updates, while provider generation logs remain opt-in during long runs.
Focused happy-dom regressions pin the collapsed provider log, bounded expanded rendering, and sync auto-open behavior without changing source, export, report, or quality scoring.

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.132 ZIP/log audit must verify the generation page no longer becomes unresponsive when progress details are inspected during enrichment.
Fresh provider evidence must still prove overall 100/100, Texture 100/100, no hidden source/review/export caveats, and agreement across UI, ZIP, manifest, reports, digest logs, and local regrade.
Source rows must remain real, trusted, on-topic, license-safe, and concept-linked across UX and Project Management domains.
Texture cleanup must continue if repeated scaffolds still appear in DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, or FAQ surfaces.
